module_description: Introduces the fundamental concepts of CSS Flexbox, including its core components and how to enable it for layout management.

topics.topic_description: Understand what Flexbox is and its purpose in modern web layout design.
Learn how to activate Flexbox for a container element to create a flex context.
Explore the two primary axes that govern the direction and alignment of Flexbox items.
Differentiate between the Flex container and its direct children, known as Flex items.

module_description: Dive into the properties applied to the Flex container, controlling the overall layout and behavior of its items.

topics.topic_description: Overview of properties applied to the flex container to manage its children's layout.
Control the direction of flex items along the main axis within the container.
Determine if flex items should wrap to multiple lines when space is limited.
Understand this shorthand property for combining flex-direction and flex-wrap values.
Align flex items along the main axis of the flex container.
Align flex items along the cross axis of the flex container.
Align flex lines along the cross axis when there is extra space and wrapping occurs.

module_description: Focus on properties applied to individual Flex items, influencing their behavior within the container layout.

topics.topic_description: Properties that control individual flex items' behavior within the container.
Change the visual order of flex items, regardless of their source order.
Define the ability of a flex item to grow if there is available space.
Define the ability of a flex item to shrink if there is not enough space.
Set the initial main size of a flex item before any available space is distributed.
Understand this combined shorthand for flex-grow, flex-shrink, and flex-basis.
Override the align-items value for a specific flex item, aligning it individually.
